scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Watercolor of a crowned, bearded king in a wooden chariot drawn by two horses, gesturing toward a walled hilltop city. Other rulers stand beside him while ranks of soldiers, mounted men, chariots and pale tents surround the hill beneath warm sunlight.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The king and coalition imaginatively represent Ben-hadad and the thirty-two kings who joined his attack on Samaria. Encircling troops, horses and chariots visualize the siege and war without graphic fighting. Only part of the coalition is shown; the faces, clothing, city and landscape are artistic conventions, not historical likenesses or an archaeological reconstruction.
